verses.en: The Word and Will of the Lord concerning the Camp of Israel in their journeyings to the West:
verses.sm: O Le Afioga ma le Finagalo o le Alii e faatatau i le tolauapiga a Isaraelu ia latou malaga i Sisifo:

verses.en: Let all the people of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and those who journey with them, be organized into companies, with a covenant and promise to keep all the commandments and statutes of the Lord our God.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i tagata uma O Le Ekalesia a Iesu Keriso o le Au Paia o Aso e Gata Ai, ma i latou o e e malaga faatasi ma i latou, ia faatulagaina i ni vaega, faatasi ma se feagaiga ma se folafolaga e tausi i poloaiga ma tulafono uma a le Alii lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Let the companies be organized with captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, and captains of tens, with a president and his two counselors at their head, under the direction of the Twelve Apostles.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i vaega e faatulaga ma ni kapeteni o taitoaselau, kapeteni o taitoalimagafulu, ma kapeteni o taitoasefulu, ma se peresitene ma ni ona fesoasoani e toalua i o latou ulu, i lalo o le taitaiga a Aposetolo e Toasefululua.

verses.en: And this shall be our covenant—that we will walk in all the ordinances of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea lenei ma a tatou feagaiga— o le a tatou savavali i sauniga uma a le Alii.

verses.en: Let each company provide themselves with all the teams, wagons, provisions, clothing, and other necessaries for the journey, that they can.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i vaega taitasi e saunia mo i latou lava ni soā manu, taavaletoso, mea manaomia, lavalava, ma isi mea e tatau ai mo le malaga, e mafai ona latou saunia.

verses.en: When the companies are organized let them go to with their might, to prepare for those who are to tarry.
verses.sm: A uma ona faatulaga o vaega ia tuu atu ia te i latou e o atu ma lo latou malosi, e sauniuni mo i latou o e o le a faamuli.

verses.en: Let each company, with their captains and presidents, decide how many can go next spring; then choose out a sufficient number of able-bodied and expert men, to take teams, seeds, and farming utensils, to go as pioneers to prepare for putting in spring crops.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i vaega taitasi, faatasi ma o latou kapeteni ma peresitene, e filifilia pe toafia e mafai ona o i le tautotogo e sosoo ai; ona filifilia lea o se aofai e lava o tagata tino-malolosi ma popoto, e ave soā manu, fatu, ma mea fai faatoaga, e o atu o ni paionia e sauni mo le totoina o to’aga o le tautotogo.

verses.en: Let each company bear an equal proportion, according to the dividend of their property, in taking the poor, the widows, the fatherless, and the families of those who have gone into the army, that the cries of the widow and the fatherless come not up into the ears of the Lord against this people.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i vaega taitasi e ave se vaega tutusa, e tusa ma le vaevaega o a latou meatotino, i le aveina o e matitiva, fafine ua oti a latou tane, e ua leai ni tamā, ma aiga o i latou o e na o i le autau, ina ia lē alu a’e le tagi a fafine ua oti a latou tane ma e ua leai ni tamā i fofoga o le Alii e faasaga i lenei nuu.

verses.en: Let each company prepare houses, and fields for raising grain, for those who are to remain behind this season; and this is the will of the Lord concerning his people.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i vaega taitasi e sauni ni fale, ma ni fanua mo le totoina o saito, mo i latou o e o le a faamuli atu i le vaitau lenei; ma o le finagalo lenei o le Alii e faatatau i lona nuu.

verses.en: Let every man use all his influence and property to remove this people to the place where the Lord shall locate a stake of Zion.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i tagata taitoatasi e faaaoga lona malosi ma ana meatotino uma e siitia atu ai lenei nuu i le nofoaga o le a faatuina ai e le Alii se siteki o Siona.

verses.en: And if ye do this with a pure heart, in all faithfulness, ye shall be blessed; you shall be blessed in your flocks, and in your herds, and in your fields, and in your houses, and in your families.
verses.sm: Ma afai tou te faia lenei mea ma le loto mamā, i le faamaoni atoa, o le a faamanuiaina outou; o le a faamanuiaina outou ia outou lafu manu, ma a outou fagaga, ma o outou fanua, ma o outou fale, ma o outou aiga.

verses.en: Let my servants Ezra T. Benson and Erastus Snow organize a company.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Ezra T. Benson ma Erastus Snow e faatulaga se vaega.

verses.en: And let my servants Orson Pratt and Wilford Woodruff organize a company.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Orson Pratt ma Wilford Woodruff e faatulaga se vaega.

verses.en: Also, let my servants Amasa Lyman and George A. Smith organize a company.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Amasa Lyman i ma Siaosi A. Samita e faatulaga se vaega.

verses.en: And appoint presidents, and captains of hundreds, and of fifties, and of tens.
verses.sm: Ma ia tofia ni peresitene, ma ni kapeteni o taitoaselau, ma taitoalimagafulu, ma taitoasefulu.

verses.en: And let my servants that have been appointed go and teach this, my will, to the saints, that they may be ready to go to a land of peace.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o e ua tofia e o atu ma aoao atu lo’u loto lenei i le au paia, ina ia latou saunia e o atu i se laueleele o le filemu.

verses.en: Go thy way and do as I have told you, and fear not thine enemies; for they shall not have power to stop my work.
verses.sm: O atu loa i lo outou ala ma faia e pei ona Ou fai atu ai ia te outou, ma aua le matata’u i o outou fili; aua o le a latou lē maua le mana e taofia ai la’u galuega.

verses.en: Zion shall be redeemed in mine own due time.
verses.sm: O le a laveaiina Siona i lo’u lava taimi e tatau ai.

verses.en: And if any man shall seek to build up himself, and seeketh not my counsel, he shall have no power, and his folly shall be made manifest.
verses.sm: Ma afai e saili soo se tasi e ati a’e o ia lava, ma lē saili mai i la’u fautuaga, o le a lē maua e ia le mana, ma o le a faaalia lona valea.

verses.en: Seek ye; and keep all your pledges one with another; and covet not that which is thy brother’s.
verses.sm: Ia outou saili; ma tausi a outou folafolaga uma o le tasi ma le isi; ma aua le manao i mea a so outou uso.

verses.en: Keep yourselves from evil to take the name of the Lord in vain, for I am the Lord your God, even the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob.
verses.sm: Ia outou tausi outou lava mai le leaga o le ta’u fua o le suafa o le Alii, aua o A’u o le Alii lo outou Atua, o le Atua lava o o outou tamā, o le Atua o Aperaamo ma Isaako ma Iakopo.

verses.en: I am he who led the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; and my arm is stretched out in the last days, to save my people Israel.
verses.sm: O A’u o lē na taitaiina ese le fanauga a Isaraelu mai le laueleele o Aikupito; ma ua faaloaloa atu lo’u lima i aso e gata ai, e lavea’i lo’u nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Cease to contend one with another; cease to speak evil one of another.
verses.sm: Tuu le fefinaua’i o le tasi ma le isi; tuu le tautala leaga o le tasi i le isi.

verses.en: Cease drunkenness; and let your words tend to edifying one another.
verses.sm: Tuu le ’onā; ma tuu atu a outou upu e fesoasoani e faagaeetia ai e le tasi le isi.

verses.en: If thou borrowest of thy neighbor, thou shalt restore that which thou hast borrowed; and if thou canst not repay then go straightway and tell thy neighbor, lest he condemn thee.
verses.sm: Afai e te nonō mai i lē lua te tuaoi, ia e toe faafoi atu le mea na e nonō mai; ma afai ua lē mafai ona e toe totogi atu, ona e alu atu sa’o lea ma ta’u atu i lē lua te tuaoi, ina ne’i tausalaina oe e ia.

verses.en: If thou shalt find that which thy neighbor has lost, thou shalt make diligent search till thou shalt deliver it to him again.
verses.sm: Afai e te maua le mea na leiloa a lē lua te tuaoi, ia e sailia ma le filiga seia e toe avatu ia te ia.

verses.en: Thou shalt be diligent in preserving what thou hast, that thou mayest be a wise steward; for it is the free gift of the Lord thy God, and thou art his steward.
verses.sm: Ia e filiga i le faasaoina o mea ua e maua, ina ia avea oe ma se tausimea atamai; ona o lea mea o se meaalofa foaifua mai le Alii lou Atua, ma o oe o sana tausimea.

verses.en: If thou art merry, praise the Lord with singing, with music, with dancing, and with a prayer of praise and thanksgiving.
verses.sm: Afai ua e fiafia, vivii atu i le Alii i pesega, ma musika, ma siva, faatasi ma se tatalo o le viiga ma le faafetai.

verses.en: If thou art sorrowful, call on the Lord thy God with supplication, that your souls may be joyful.
verses.sm: Afai ua e faanoanoa, ole atu i le Alii lou Atua i le loto maualalo, ina ia olioli o outou agaga.

verses.en: Fear not thine enemies, for they are in mine hands and I will do my pleasure with them.
verses.sm: Aua le matata’u i o outou fili, ona ua i ai i latou i o’u lima ma o le a Ou faia ia te i latou le mea Ou te loto i ai.

verses.en: My people must be tried in all things, that they may be prepared to receive the glory that I have for them, even the glory of Zion; and he that will not bear chastisement is not worthy of my kingdom.
verses.sm: E ao ina tofotofoina lo’u nuu i mea uma, ina ia latou saunia e maua le mamalu ua ia te A’u mo i latou, o le mamalu lava lea o Siona; ma o ia o lē e lē onosaia le aoaiga e lē agavaa mo lo’u malo.

verses.en: Let him that is ignorant learn wisdom by humbling himself and calling upon the Lord his God, that his eyes may be opened that he may see, and his ears opened that he may hear;
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia o lē ua valea e aoao le poto i le faamaualaloina o ia lava ma le ole atu i le Alii lona Atua, ina ia tatalaina ona mata ina ia mafai ona vaai o ia, ma tatalaina ona taliga ina ia mafai ona faalogo o ia;

verses.en: For my Spirit is sent forth into the world to enlighten the humble and contrite, and to the condemnation of the ungodly.
verses.sm: Aua ua auina atu lo’u Agaga i le lalolagi e faamalamalama e ua lotomaualalo ma loto salamo, ma mo le ta’usalaina o e ua lē amioatua.

verses.en: Thy brethren have rejected you and your testimony, even the nation that has driven you out;
verses.sm: Ua teena outou ma la outou molimau e o outou uso, le atunuu lea ua tutulieseina outou i fafo;

verses.en: And now cometh the day of their calamity, even the days of sorrow, like a woman that is taken in travail; and their sorrow shall be great unless they speedily repent, yea, very speedily.
verses.sm: Ma ua oo mai nei le aso o lo latou mala, o aso lava o le faanoanoa, e pei o se fafine ua faatiga; ma o le a matua tele lava lo latou faanoanoa vagana ai ua vave ona latou salamo, ioe, ia vave lava.

verses.en: For they killed the prophets, and them that were sent unto them; and they have shed innocent blood, which crieth from the ground against them.
verses.sm: Aua ua latou fasioti perofeta, ma i latou o e na auina atu ia te i latou; ma ua latou faamasaaina toto lē sala, ua tagi mai le eleele e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: Therefore, marvel not at these things, for ye are not yet pure; ye can not yet bear my glory; but ye shall behold it if ye are faithful in keeping all my words that I have given you, from the days of Adam to Abraham, from Abraham to Moses, from Moses to Jesus and his apostles, and from Jesus and his apostles to Joseph Smith, whom I did call upon by mine angels, my ministering servants, and by mine own voice out of the heavens, to bring forth my work;
verses.sm: O lea, aua le ofo i nei mea, ona tou te lei mamā lava; e lei mafai lava ona outou lavatia lo’u mamalu; ae o le a outou vaaia pe afai tou te faamaoni i le tausiga o a’u upu uma ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou, mai aso o Atamu ia Aperaamo, mai ia Aperaamo ia Mose, mai ia Mose ia Iesu ma ana aposetolo, ma mai ia Iesu ma ana aposetolo ia Iosefa Samita, o lē na Ou valaau atu i ai e ala i a’u agelu, a’u auauna galulue, ma i lo’u lava leo mai le lagi, e aumai la’u galuega;

verses.en: Which foundation he did lay, and was faithful; and I took him to myself.
verses.sm: O lona faavae na faataatia e ia, ma sa faamaoni; ma ua Ou ave o ia ia te a’u lava.

verses.en: Many have marveled because of his death; but it was needful that he should seal his testimony with his blood, that he might be honored and the wicked might be condemned.
verses.sm: Sa ofo le toatele i lona maliu; ae sa manaomia ona tatau ona faamau faailoga e ia lana molimau i lona toto, ina ia faamamaluina o ia ma ina ia tausalaina ai e ua amioleaga.

verses.en: Have I not delivered you from your enemies, only in that I have left a witness of my name?
verses.sm: Pe Ou te lei laveaiina ea outou mai i o outou fili, i se ala lava na Ou tuua ai se molimau o lo’u igoa?

verses.en: Now, therefore, hearken, O ye people of my church; and ye elders listen together; you have received my kingdom.
verses.sm: O lea, o lenei, uai mai ia, E outou e tagata o la’u ekalesia; ma o outou toeaina ia faalogo mai faatasi; ua outou mauaina lo’u malo.

verses.en: Be diligent in keeping all my commandments, lest judgments come upon you, and your faith fail you, and your enemies triumph over you. So no more at present. Amen and Amen.
verses.sm: Ia outou filiga i le tausiga o a’u poloaiga uma, ne’i oo mai faamasinoga i o outou luga, ma vaivai ai lo outou faatuatua, ma manumalo ai o outou fili ia te outou. O lea ua leai ni isi mea i le taimi nei. Amene ma Amene.
